pokedexEntries.x: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

pokedexEntries.or: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

pokedexEntries.y: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent’s will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

pokedexEntries.as: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent’s will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

pokedexEntries.us: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

pokedexEntries.um: When exchanging information with others of its kind, it flashes the light-emitting spots on its body in a complex rhythm.

pokedexEntries.sw: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

pokedexEntries.sh: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

pokedexEntries.sc: It protects itself from tough foes by flashing its luminescent spots to discourage them.

pokedexEntries.vi: Being upside-down improves its blood flow and clears its mind, causing the power of its psychic moves to increase dramatically.

pokedexEntries.za: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.
